Nothing on a public digital-skills programme.

systems.platform: eight tools incl. e-Sante Comm, NetSIGL 2.0, e-Flux Financier
systems.owner: Ministry of Health with Health Systems Insight

BFA.note: The eight pilot tools are community, stock, finance and decision-support tools and the source does not call any a routine aggregate reporting system or a patient record.
The pilot covers 100 facilities in two districts and the source says its tools run as standalone systems; it does not call any a health management information system.
